{{Quote|Here is your chance to prove the power of your promises, Jedi&hellip;will you help us now, to defend our city?''"<br />"''Yes&mdash;we'd be honored!|Queen Amanoa and Ulic Qel-Droma, as the Beast Riders storm the Royal Palace|audio=RaidOnIzizRoyalPalace1-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
The '''raid on the Iziz Royal Palace''' that took place in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], was a preconceived plot developed by the [[Beast Riders]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] wilderness, to abduct [[Galia]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of Onderon. After spending years in exile from the lone [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the Beast Riders managed to secretly infiltrate the city, and began trading information with the citizens who were against the rule of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]]. It was also during this time that [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]], met and fell in love with Galia. Because the couple knew that the Queen would not allow their union, they developed a plot in which the Beast Riders would attack the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] of Iziz and kidnap Galia. As part of the abduction, the Princess would be taken to Kira's [[Kira Fortress|forest stronghold]] to [[Binding Ceremony|wed]] the Beast-Lord. Waiting for the right time, an opportunity arose when three [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] arrived on Onderon to facilitate peace negotiations between the Beast Riders of the planet's wilderness and the citizens of the Iziz.

Through their underground contacts, the Beast Riders learned that the city-dwellers had requested aid from the Republic. The Riders then planned to use the Jedi's arrival as the distraction they required to carry out their planned abduction. The mounted warriors encountered the Knights in the Onderonian atmosphere and attacked [[Nebulon Ranger|their]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], paying out [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster]] fire before the Knights could even land. The Jedi received assistance from Iziz's [[Iziz defense tower|defense towers]], however, who covered their landing and repelled Kira's forces with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bombardment. The Beast Riders momentarily halted the chase as the Jedi successfully landed in the city, where they were brought them before the Queen and her daughter.

As [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|one of the Jedi]] offered the protection of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to the Queen, Kira and his men managed to penetrate not only the city wall defenses, but the palace, as well. Several warbeasts and their Riders overtook the throne room as Amanoa's [[Royal Protector]]s ushered her and Galia to safety while the Jedi met the intruders in combat. Two of the warriors, special [[Beast Warrior Commando]]s, slipped passed the Jedi and followed after the Queen's entourage. The warrior pair defeated the Royal Protectors and successfully abducted Galia. Amanoa was lightly stunned in the commotion, and the Beast Riders promptly departed, having successfully carried out their mission. In turn, the Queen demanded that the Jedi have the Princess returned at once.

==Background==
{{Quote|I've got a visual sighting, Ulic. Those aren't birds&mdash;they're Beast Riders, armed with&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;Heavy blasters?! Beginning evasive maneuvers!|Tott Doneeta and Ulic Qel-Droma, upon entering the Onderonian atmosphere|audio=RaidOnIzizRoyalPalace2-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
[[File:Iziz-talesofthejedi.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Jedi arrive on the planet Onderon.]]
Dating back to approximately [[4400 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the world of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Japrael system/Legends|of the same name]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> had been embroiled in a worldwide conflict known as the [[Beast Wars]]. The [[Beast Riders]] from the planet's wilderness, sought to end the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;rule and oppression of [[Amanoa]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], from Onderon's only [[City/Legends|city]]. By the year [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Beast Riders managed to infiltrate the city. Within the city, there were city-dwellers who were also against Amanoa's rule. These citizens formed Iziz's political underground, and began to assist the Beast Riders, exchanging information with their young leader, [[Beast-Lord]] Oron Kira. During the years of steady trading with those dissident city dwellers, Kira met and fell in love with [[Galia]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of Iziz. Both Kira and Galia desired to be wed, but realized that such a [[Binding Ceremony|union]] would never be allowed by the Queen. They planned to one day stage a kidnapping, in which Galia would be abducted from the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] by the Beast Riders and taken away to [[Kira Fortress|their fortress]] to marry.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Amanoa realized that a war with the Beast Riders was beyond her capability of winning, so she requested the assistance of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who had the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] mediate the dispute on her behalf.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> The Jedi installed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] as the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|watchman]] of the Onderon system, and he in turn he sent his apprentices, [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic]] and [[Cay Qel-Droma]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]], to Onderon.<ref name="BWOO" /> The Beast Riders learned of the scheduled arrival of the emissaries of the Republic, and decided go forward with their plan to assault the palace, using the Jedi's presence as the distraction the Riders needed to kidnap the Princess.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Leading a special squad of Riders known as [[Beast Warrior Commando]]s, Oron Kira and his [[Commander/Legends|second-in-command]], [[Gobee]], immediately caught sight of the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]''{{'s}} entrance into the Onderonian atmosphere. They attacked, pounding the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster fire]].<ref name="TOTJA" /> In response to a distress [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] from the Jedi's ship to the city, Iziz directed the fire of its [[Iziz defense tower|network of wall defenses]] to cover the Jedi, beating back the Beast Riders' initial attack over the city's northern wall. In the process, the insurgents suffered several casualties. The Beast Riders ceased their attack in the face of such superior firepower, and regrouped. The Jedi, meanwhile, landed safely at the [[Iziz Starport|royal starport]], and they were quickly ushered into the Queen's presence.<ref name="BWOO" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|You Beast Riders have ''killed'' her!''"<br />"''Don't worry Princess, she's only lightly stunned&hellip;she'll come around in a few seconds. Now, let's go. You're coming with us!|Princess Galia and Oron Kira, at the moment of her apprehension|audio=RaidOnIzizRoyalPalace3-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
While the Jedi were being introduced to the Queen, Kira and Gobee prepared to resume their attack. They assaulted the northern wall again, this time penetrating its defenses. They then proceeded unhindered to the palace and crashed through a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|window]] and into the throne room. There, Kira, Gobee, and the Warrior Commandos engaged both the Jedi and the Queen's minions. Amanoa and Galia were immediately surrounded by the [[Royal Protector]]s, who were determined to defend the Queen and her daughter at all costs.<ref name="BWOO" /> The Jedi managed to repelled blaster shots with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and slay several of the warbeasts, as well as their riders. While the Knights were preoccupied, Kira and Gobee disembarked from their mounts, and left the melee in pursuit of the Queen and the object of their design, Galia. They caught up with Amanoa's Royal Protectors, who had safely secured the Queen and her daughter and were now focused on preventing the intruders from advancing any further. Kira and Gobee easily dispatched with the Protectors and stormed the room where the Queen and her daughter were sequestered.<ref name="TOTJA" /> Kira and Gobee made short work of the remaining guards as they burst through the doors and confronted Amanoa, who in a moment of despair, attempted to [[Invoke spirits|invoke]] the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. When her attempt brought forth no results, Gobee stunned the Queen with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Kira then claimed Princess Galia and took her into custody. Along with Gobee, the Beast-Lord immediately left the palace.<ref name="BWOO" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Ulic Qel-Droma&mdash;is ''this'' my reward for asking you to help our beleaguered city&mdash;the loss of my daughter?! I demand, in the name of the Republic, that you seek out the kidnappers and bring her back!|Queen Amanoa|audio=RaidOnIzizRoyalPalace4-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
[[File:PoorAmanoa.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The Jedi find the Queen after Galia's abduction.]]
Kira and his men sped off back into the wilderness, leaving the city dwellers to recover from an attack they were completely unprepared for. With he and Galia joined and away from Amanoa, preparations were made for their [[Binding Ceremony of Oron Kira and Galia|their wedding]]. In the palace, Amanoa cursed the Jedi, blaming them for failing to protect both she and her daughter. When they inquired as to Galia's whereabouts, the Queen sobbed that she had been spirited away by the Beast Riders. As foremost of the Jedi, the Queen held Ulic Qel-Droma personally responsible for the events that had transpired. She then demanded that the Jedi leave her in search of the Princess, not to return until Galia was safely with them. Qel-Droma readily accepted the Queen's order, but was rebuked by his Jedi brethren, who suggested that they report the deteriorated situation to Master Jeth before proceeding. Qel-Droma refused that plan, and vowed that the Jedi would not return until Galia had been safely rescued.<ref name="TOTJA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on the Iziz Royal Palace was conceived and written by author [[Tom Veitch]], and first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon|''Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] series of comics. Veitch used this event as part of an introduction to a whole new cast of characters, and to tell the story of the lives of Jedi Knights, four thousand years before [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] time.<ref name="TVI">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Tom Veitch|Interview with Tom Veitch]]</ref> Veitch also used this event as the first official mission of his new characters Ulic and Cay Qel-Droma, and Tott Doneeta,<ref name="BWOO" /> who were first illustrated by artist [[Chris Gossett]].<ref name="CGI">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Christian Gossett|Interview with Christian Gossett]]</ref> The story was later given new life with the [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|full-cast audio drama rendition]] of ''Tales of the Jedi'', scripted by [[John Whitman]].
